rationale.conceptual: The method involves composing 145 domain-specific features, training decision tree ensembles, and implementing a hierarchical partitioning scheme based on chemical knowledge. It requires understanding materials informatics and careful feature engineering, but the core ML is standard (Random Subspace + REPTree).
rationale.execution: The pipeline includes several stages: acquiring and filtering the OQMD dataset, computing features with Magpie/matminer, training a global model, training a partitioned model (with interval classifier and chemical subgroups), and generating output CSVs. Dependencies include external libraries and a public database, with non-trivial data assembly and multiple load-bearing handoffs.
